- [ ] `pytest -q` green
- [ ] `python app/build.py --check` green

- [ ] Engine parity: any change to `screening.py` (or modules it calls) is mirrored in `app/engine.js`
- [ ] No invented thresholds, coefficients, legal citations, dates or statuses (named source, or marked `placeholder` / `verify`)
